title: AgingBrain Simulator
description:
Open the simulators online: https://buckner-lab.github.io/Aging-Brain-Simulator/

Every published version of the AgingBrain Simulator, from version 1 to version 104, together with the scripts that reproduce each panel of the figures and supplementary figures of Buckner et al., Synthesizing and Predicting Brain and Cognitive Aging Data Patterns Using an Evolving Simulator Enabled by Agentic Artificial Intelligence (bioRxiv, forthcoming).

The simulator generates worlds of 120,000 individual lives. Each life starts from baseline parameters (genetic risk, birth year, childhood ability, and others) and changes with age through explicit causal cascades (aging, cardiovascular, the AD cascade, sleep, engagement, LATE). The simulator then runs studies on those worlds through selection, measurement, follow-up and intervention stages. Each version is a single HTML file that runs entirely in a web browser.
